question: A is thrice as efficient as B. Together they can complete a work in 12 days. In how many days can B alone complete the work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency ratio of **A : B = 3 : 1**

Total efficiency of **(A + B)** = 3 + 1 = **4 units/day**

Total work = Combined efficiency × Total days = 4 × 12 = **48 units**

Time taken by **B alone** = Total work ÷ B's efficiency = 48 ÷ 1 = **48 days**

**∴ The correct answer is 48 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Efficiency of **A** = 3 × Efficiency of **B**

Time taken by **(A + B)** together = **12 days**

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

Combined efficiency of **A + B** = 3 + 1 = **4 units/day**

⇒ Total Work = Combined Efficiency × Total Time

⇒ Total Work = 4 × 12 = **48 units**

⇒ Time taken by **B alone** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of B

⇒ Time taken by **B alone** = 48 ÷ 1 = **48 days**

**∴ The correct answer is 48 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Inversion

Efficiency is **inversely proportional** to the time taken. If efficiency ratio is x : y, the time ratio is y : x.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed based on the **ratio of work done**, which is equivalent to the ratio of efficiencies if time is constant.

Pipes and Cisterns

This concept is identical to **Time and Work**, where filling a tank is positive work and emptying it is negative work.</p
